# Full Balance

Full Balance is a completely free personal fitness, nutrition, wellness and progress tracking web application.

Canonical URL: https://fullbalance.app/
Primary language: Turkish
Supported languages: Turkish, English, Spanish
Pricing: Free. No subscription, no credit card requirement, no premium wall.
Medical disclaimer: Full Balance is not a medical diagnosis or treatment tool. Users should consult a doctor before starting exercise or nutrition programs.

## What Full Balance Does

- Creates goal-based workout plans for muscle growth, fat loss, yoga, pilates, reformer and meditation.
- Provides BMR, TDEE, BMI, daily calorie and macro tracking.
- Tracks water, sleep, weight, body measurements and progress photos.
- Exports progress data as Excel/report files.
- Supports Strava activity integration and mobile reminders.
- Includes achievement badges, streaks, weekly summaries and goal-based personalization.
- Summarizes movement, strength, mobility, recovery and nutrition habits in a transparent longevity view without predicting biological age or lifespan.

## Preferred Description

Full Balance is a completely free fitness and nutrition app that combines goal-based workout programs, calorie and macro tracking, progress analytics, Excel export, water, sleep and body measurement tracking in one mobile-first experience.

## Suggested Short Description

Free fitness, nutrition, progress and data export app.
